Preview

  • 2026-10-06 at 12:35 GMT marks a key Friendly International encounter between China PR and Tajikistan in 2026's Friendlies.
  • There is no recorded managerial head-to-head between B. Ivanković and Igor Angelovski.
  • Neither China PR nor Tajikistan are missing any players.
  • Our forecast has China PR in a 4-man backline (4-4-2), with Tajikistan set to counter in 4-1-4-1.
  • Last time out, Fei Nanduo registered the best mark for China PR - 6.9 - and M. Rahimov did likewise for Tajikistan with an 6.9 score.
  • China PR lost 0-5 to Palestine, and Tajikistan were defeated 2-4 by Palestine.
  • Neither side is flying – China PR 2-1-2 and Tajikistan 1-2-2 over the last 5 matches.
  • Dominance for China PR: across 2 clashes, they've won 1 game and only lost 0 games to Tajikistan, with 1 stalemates.
  • With both sides enjoying similar home/away returns (1-2-2 vs 0-0-1) and scoring roughly 0.60-2.00 goals, a 2-2 draw seems on the cards.
